speaker: RD
text: Medic 7, fall, seventy-eight year old female, lift assist requested.

speaker: BY
text: She's in the kitchen, she went down about twenty minutes ago.

speaker: M1
text: Ma'am, did you trip, or did you feel funny before you fell?

speaker: PT
text: I got dizzy, my heart was going so fast, and then I was on the floor.

speaker: M1
text: Did you hit your head? Are you on blood thinners?

speaker: PT
text: I don't think so. I take Eliquis and metoprolol. I'm allergic to penicillin.

speaker: M1
text: Okay. Found her on the floor, alert, no obvious injury, but this isn't just a fall.

speaker: M2
text: Heart rate's 148 and irregular, BP 96 over 60, sat 93.

speaker: M1
text: Get the monitor on her and a twelve lead.

speaker: M2
text: She's a GCS 15, A and O times four.

speaker: M1
text: Let's go, we're transporting to General.

speaker: M1
text: Report's given, transfer of care complete.
